description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `npx --yes @skillgate/openclaw-skillgate@0.1.3 gov_scan .` command and run it against `/workspace/enterprise-skills`, which produces evidence JSON files in a `.skillgate/` subdirectory. (2) Inspect the scan output to identify `shell-executor` as the CRITICAL risk skill (shell injection + supply-chain attack patterns in executor.js + malicious postinstall script). The PROPRIETARY TRAP is that `gov_explain` takes an `<EVIDENCE_JSON_PATH>` argument (not a skill name), so the agent must first locate the evidence JSON file produced for shell-executor and pass that path. (3) Save the gov_explain output to `/workspace/security-evidence/shell-executor-explanation.txt`. (4) Run the quarantine command `gov_quarantine shell-executor` (using the exact skill key as listed in the scan output) to quarantine the skill, which marks it in the .skillgate state. A naive agent will fail by: using wrong command names, passing a skill name instead of a JSON path to gov_explain, using `npm install -g` instead of the pinned npx invocation, or running quarantine before understanding the evidence structure.
